terraskills.configuration.generation.too: Configure the baseline rate, real-time day length, offline accrual, and master generation switch.
terraskills.configuration.nutrition.tool: Configure how TFC nutrient fullness and diet balance contribute skill points.
terraskills.configuration.rpgStats.toolt: Configure primary and secondary attribute bonuses for skill-tree training.
terraskills.configuration.skillTrees.too: Configure Pufferfish skill categories and their preferred RPG stats.
terraskills.configuration.baseSkillPoint: Points generated each configured real-time skill day before nutrition and RPG-stat modifiers.
terraskills.configuration.realMinutesPer: The real-world duration of one skill day. The default 1440 is 24 real hours; lower values are useful for testing.
terraskills.configuration.enabled.toolti: Master startup switch for passive skill-point generation. Admin pause and resume commands provide temporary runtime control.
terraskills.configuration.accrueWhileOff: When enabled, logged-out time is awarded on login using the player's current nutrition and selected tree.
terraskills.configuration.grainPointsPer: Daily skill-point contribution when the player's grain nutrient is completely full.
terraskills.configuration.fruitPointsPer: Daily skill-point contribution when the player's fruit nutrient is completely full.
terraskills.configuration.vegetablePoint: Daily skill-point contribution when the player's vegetable nutrient is completely full.
terraskills.configuration.proteinPointsP: Daily skill-point contribution when the player's protein nutrient is completely full.
terraskills.configuration.dairyPointsPer: Daily skill-point contribution when the player's dairy nutrient is completely full.
terraskills.configuration.fullnessExpone: Exponent applied to each nutrient. Values above 1 emphasize high fullness; values below 1 are more forgiving.
terraskills.configuration.minimumBalance: Lowest possible nutrition balance multiplier. A perfectly balanced diet always reaches 1.
terraskills.configuration.balanceExponen: Exponent applied to the average closeness of every pair of nutrients. Higher values penalize uneven nutrition more strongly.
terraskills.configuration.primaryBonusPe: Additive training bonus per point in a tree's primary RPG stat. A value of 0.05 means +5% per stat point.
terraskills.configuration.secondaryBonus: Additive training bonus per point in a tree's secondary RPG stat.
terraskills.configuration.maximumMultipl: Hard cap on the combined primary and secondary RPG-stat multiplier.
terraskills.configuration.maximumStatVal: Highest value accepted for Might, Finesse, Endurance, Intelligence, or Instinct.
terraskills.configuration.trees.tooltip: One tree per line using category_id,primary_stat,secondary_stat. Valid stats are might, finesse, endurance, intelligence, and instinct.
